architecture_options.name: Mac Mini + small public ingress VPS
architecture_options.topology: Internet -> VPS (reverse proxy / TLS ingress, TLS, rate limit) -> Mac Mini (FastAPI, PostgreSQL, storage)
stateful_components: Document storage on Mac Mini external SSD
architecture_options.network_flow: Public traffic -> VPS port 443 (TLS) -> authenticated encrypted private tunnel -> Mac Mini port 8000
advantages: preserves existing Mac Mini and 4 TB SSD investment
security_considerations: VPS must be hardened (SSH key, firewall, automated brute-force protection)
TLS termination on VPS exposes only HTTPS to the internet
VPS-to-Mac Mini connection via authenticated encrypted private tunnel
architecture_options.when_it_fits: pilot phase (5-10 clients), no contractual SLA, development/demo
architecture_options.when_it_stops_fitting: contractual SLA, client requires 24/7, formalized backup RPO/RTO, >10 active clients
architecture_options.migration_path: to Option B: decommission Mac Mini; to Option C: incremental migration

architecture_options.name: Single VPS or dedicated server
architecture_options.topology: Internet -> Single server (reverse proxy + FastAPI + PostgreSQL + storage)
architecture_options.network_flow: Public -> server port 443 (TLS) -> reverse proxy -> local port 8000
limitations: no HA (single machine failure = everything down)
architecture_options.when_it_fits: post-pilot scale-out before HA required, 10-20 active clients
architecture_options.when_it_stops_fitting: HA requirement, separate DB scaling needed, regulatory data isolation
architecture_options.migration_path: from Option A: migrate data; to Option C: split services

architecture_options.name: Split contour
architecture_options.topology: Internet -> Reverse proxy -> App node(s) -> PostgreSQL node -> Document storage -> Backup storage
architecture_options.network_flow: Public -> reverse proxy (TLS) -> app (internal) -> PostgreSQL (internal); app -> document storage; app -> EIS/LLM (outbound)
security_considerations: IAM for shared filesystem or object-compatible storage
authenticated encrypted private tunnel between nodes
architecture_options.when_it_fits: production with SLA, legal/customer requirements for data placement/isolation/availability/on-premise, 20+ active clients
architecture_options.migration_path: from Option A or B: incremental per component
